sets.title: Wheels that also interact
sets.query: manamap pilot card-search --deck sharknado --all --oracle '(discards? (their|your) hand|discard any number|shuffles? (their|your) hand|puts? (their|your) hand on the bottom|each player (discards|shuffles)|then draws? (that many|seven|cards equal))' --oracle '(counter target|destroy (target|all|each)|exile (target|all|each)|return (target|all|each).{0,40}(owner|hand)|deals? \d+ damage to (target|each|any)|damage to any target)' --limit 60

cards.name: Fateful Showdown
cards.why: instant: damage equal to your hand size to any target, then discard the hand and draw that many

cards.name: Collective Defiance
cards.why: escalate: wheel yourself (discard all, draw that many) plus 4 to a creature and 3 to an opponent

cards.name: Incendiary Command
cards.why: choose two: everyone wheels, 2 to each creature, 4 to a player — a wheel with a small sweeper

cards.name: The Elder Dragon War
cards.why: saga: 2 to each creature and opponent, then discard any and draw that many, then a 4/4 flying Dragon

cards.name: Rites of Refusal
cards.why: instant: discard any number to counter a spell unless they pay 3 per card — the discard IS the counter

cards.name: Null Brooch
cards.why: discard your hand: counter a noncreature spell, every turn — a counterspell on a stick, no draw

cards.name: Snort
cards.why: each player may wheel to five; every opponent who does takes 5; flashback wheels again

cards.name: Moonveil Regent
cards.why: flyer: on every spell you may discard your hand and draw one per colour of that spell — a repeatable wheel

cards.name: Jace, the Mind Sculptor
cards.why: 0: draw three, put two back every turn; −1 bounces a creature — a Game Changer

cards.name: Joshua, Phoenix's Dominant // Phoenix, Warden of Fire
cards.why: enters: discard two, draw two; flips into a saga that burns each opponent and returns creatures

cards.name: Cathartic Pyre
cards.why: instant, choose one: 3 to a creature or planeswalker, OR discard two and draw two — not both

cards.name: Day's Undoing
cards.why: everyone shuffles hand and graveyard back and draws seven; ends your turn; no interaction

cards.name: Hex Magic
cards.why: exile your hand and draw that many, playable next turn — exile is not discard, so no Brallin

cards.name: Into the Fire
cards.why: choose one: 2 to every creature, OR bottom any number and draw that many plus one — a bottom, so no Brallin

cards.name: Invasion of Kaldheim // Pyre of the World Tree
cards.why: enters: exile hand, draw that many (Shabraz); flipped, each land you discard pings any target for 2 (Brallin)

cards.name: Chandra, Heart of Fire
cards.why: +1 discard your hand and impulse three; +1 2 damage to any target — a discard with no draw

cards.name: Chandra, Flame's Catalyst
cards.why: +1 3 to each opponent every turn; −8 discard your hand, draw seven and cast them free

cards.name: Umaro, Raging Yeti
cards.why: each combat, at random: team pump, discard your hand and draw four, or 5 to any target — random

cards.name: Ajani Unrelenting
cards.why: −2 discard your hand, draw one per creature; −3 4 to each creature but your tokens

cards.name: Chandra Ablaze
cards.why: +1 discard a red card for 4 to any target; −2 everyone discards their hand and draws three

cards.name: Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker
cards.why: −3 4 to a creature; +1 a 4/4 flying haste Dragon; ultimate draws two and discards the hand each turn

cards.name: Serum Powder
cards.why: a mana rock; its hand reset works only at mulligan, so it pays neither commander

cards.name: Apocalypse
cards.why: exile ALL permanents (yours too) and discard your hand — a total reset

cards.name: Colossus of the Blood Age
cards.why: enters: 3 to each opponent, gain 3; dies: discard any number, draw that many plus one

cards.name: Turtles in Time
cards.why: bounce every creature, then everyone may shuffle hand and graveyard back and draw seven — a 7-mana reset
